rows.concrete_observation: Registered SpellRay player cast actually raytraces and invokes subclass onEntityHit; returned flag clips client particle ray and permits generic cast sound. MindTrick server EntityLiving branch first setAttackTarget(null), then calls void addPotionEffect(mind_trick); no canControl/isNonBoss/blacklist check in this method. Player instead receives nausea. Eligible Living client independently spawns ten dark particles and returns true, without effect acceptance receipt. Native annotated LivingSetAttackTarget subscriber clears a nonnull target while mind_trick OR fear is active, avoids recursive null handling. LivingAttack subscriber removes mind_trick when trueSource is Living, without testing final damage success; nonliving environmental sources do not release through this handler.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Explicitly separate one-shot AI mutation before effect admission, sustained target suppression and later release on attack attempt. A rejected potion does not undo an earlier cleared target. Contact particles/cast sound cannot prove state admitted, and release at Attack stage is not proof HP was lost. A final Boss refusal must precede these non-damage side effects.

rows.concrete_observation: Registered IceStatue/Petrify onEntityHit server EntityLiving calls BlockStatue.convertToStatue but ignores false via empty if and returns true; onMiss also true, so generic cast/particle success is not conversion proof. Converter rejects deathTime>0/client, then resets hurtTime and extinguishes BEFORE placement eligibility. It tries one/two/three blocks (a failed short branch may fall through to taller branches). Replaceability and per-block permission gate placement, including player edit/config/world protection/Forge place cancellation or mobGriefing. setBlockState results are ignored; each found TE receives same creature object/part, bottom lifetime; then marks frozen/petrified, setDead and returns true without verifying TE capture. No explicit Boss/nonBoss or potion admission gate appears in converter. Native registered ITickable statue retains actor object or reconstructs it from entityName/entity NBT; timer/lifetime/parts/ice/yaw saved and sent through TE update methods. Ice bottom destroys at timer>lifetime; stone bottom only every200ticks after minimum lifetime and code light<rand.nextInt(12)-3 (comments are not exact policy). breakBlock destroys companions; bottom clears PETRIFIED only, resets isDead=false and spawnEntity, ignoring spawn result. RenderStatue renders bottom actor proxy at block coordinates; stone temporarily sets invisible true then unconditionally false. Frost shouldRender is (!invisible && frostPotion) OR frozenNBT, so frozen bypasses invisible test. Cached Java search finds frozen writes here and render/model reads, no explicit frozen-tag removal; this is bounded static residue evidence, not a runtime permanence claim.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: An actor removed into block storage is a different control substrate from a potion or mounted restraint. Final refusal must run before extinguish/removal/replacement, and success feedback must depend on committed capture/restoration rather than caller true. Restoration requires clearing correct state and checking spawn outcome; proxy rendering/TE update is not proof the live actor has been restored. Reuse only the lifecycle lesson, not this invasive mechanic for the requested Boss feedback.

Russell must judge semantic overlap; all generic NBT/GL utilities zero.
rows.limitations: Static only, no block callback ordering/rollback, vanilla world spawn admission, entity serializer or actual late-join/run proven. No duplication exploit, guaranteed Boss capture, permanent frozen state or network consistency asserted. Forge place-event internals not read; visible call-site checks are documented, not claimed comprehensive protection. Full native TE update methods, not fabricated handler invocation. No production changes.
